requirements.quote: `apps/admin` Coverage: a matrix of forums (grouped by state and court type) against data types, each cell showing the level, freshness and volume, filterable by state.
A gap list ranked by demand (watches and users in that forum) times missing level.
A weekly coverage report (email to staff) with the change since last week.
Every forum in the catalogue appears with a level per data type. [type:integration]
The gap ranking uses live demand (watch counts). [type:unit]

deliverables.change: New. Pure functions: sourcesForForum (source id `<prefix>:<type>`; prefix equals forum code, is a dotted ancestor, or is `in.<st>.district` for district-kind forums of state <st>), buildCoverage (every enabled catalogue forum with workspace_id null x data types cause_list, case_status, order, display_board, notice; level = highest access_mode of cleared, non-killed matching sources else 'none'; freshness = latest successful fetch_log fetch (status 200-399); volume = successful fetches in 7 days), rankGaps (score = demand watches/users x (3 - level index, none lowest); deterministic tie-break by forum code), diffCoverage (week-over-week change derived from source cleared_at / first fetch, no snapshot table), plus a reader over source, forum, fetch_log, notice and the demand function. Export from packages/core/src/sources/index.ts.

New hand-written migration (use next free timestamp after 20261024090000_ecourts_district_status_sources; rename if base took it): SECURITY DEFINER app_staff_watch_demand() returning source_id, watches, users over case_watch (enabled) and cause_list_watch; calls app_staff_require_caller(); REVOKE FROM PUBLIC, GRANT to causedeck_app, causedeck_clerk; aggregates only, modelled on 0082_staff_conflict_rate.sql. Add the matching entry to migrations/meta/_journal.json and a snapshot file.

Add audited coverageOverview(staff, now?, db?) using staffCall (function app_staff_watch_demand) and staffQuery (tables forum, source, fetch_log, notice) with purpose `coverage.overview`; never import withoutWorkspace elsewhere.

New server component, requireStaff capability for coverage: matrix grouped by state then court type x 5 data types (level, freshness, volume per cell), `?state=` filter, ranked gap list. Counts, ids, levels and times only (no content fields).
Add Coverage nav item (/coverage) and extend the href union; update header comment.
Add `coverage` staff capability for ops and admin (or reuse data-ops if lint/guard tests prefer); keep support without it.

New job `system.coverage.weekly`, cron `30 9 * * 1`, singleton key, injectable email/now/recipients deps; recipients are enabled ops/admin staff emails; emails top gaps and change since last week; nothing sent when no recipients.
Import and register coverageWeekly in the definitions list and the type map.
Add `system.coverage.weekly` to the expected job names.

New unit tests: mapping rule, level selection (uncleared/killed => none), freshness/volume, every catalogue forum has 5 cells (R4), rankGaps reorders when stubbed watch counts change (R5), diffCoverage.
New page test with mocked lib/data: matrix renders every forum with five data-type cells, state filter narrows, gap list order, access denied for support role.

Register new runtime core exports from coverage.ts in NOT_A_SERVICE (pure functions) or SERVICE_TESTS for the reader, with a reason; add a real case in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts if SERVICE_TESTS is chosen.

preserve.what: sourceOpsOverview, staffParseYield, staffConflictRate and Data Ops page behaviour in packages/core/src/sources/ops.ts and apps/admin/app/(console)/data-ops/page.tsx.
Admin guard tests: pages never import withoutWorkspace, no content fields (apps/admin/__tests__/{data-layer,server-component-imports,no-content-fields,no-without-workspace-outside-data}.test.ts).
Tenant isolation: staff see only aggregate counts of case_watch/cause_list_watch through the definer function; no workspace, proceeding, party or user id leaves it.
Existing job schedules and business digest in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/business-digest.ts and registry ordering/typing in packages/core/src/jobs/registry.ts.

pnpm --filter @causedeck/worker exec vitest run src/__tests__/registry.test.ts src/__tests__/schedules.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/testing

decisions.choice: Derive 'change since last week' from source.cleared_at and fetch_log history instead of a new coverage_snapshot table.
decisions.justification: A new global table triggers the db root-table list, GLOBAL_TABLES, grants and RLS catalogue updates (CLAUDE.md registries table); source.cleared_at (schema/source-registry.ts:60) and fetch_log (schema/fetch-log.ts:9) already hold the dates.

decisions.choice: Read tenant watch demand only through a new SECURITY DEFINER function, like app_staff_conflict_rate.
decisions.justification: case_watch and cause_list_watch are tenant tables under FORCE RLS (schema/case-watch.ts:1-6); precedent migrations/0082_staff_conflict_rate.sql and core sources/ops.ts:165.

decisions.choice: Model the weekly email on system.business.digest (defineJob, cron, injected deps).
Source-to-forum mapping by id prefix (forum code, dotted ancestor, or in.<st>.district for district forums) in one tested function.
decisions.justification: Source ids are `<scope>:<type>` with state-wide district ids (migrations 20261024090000_ecourts_district_status_sources.sql) and per-forum ids (0076_display_board.sql:49-71); forum codes per schema/court.ts:41 and ecourts/snapshot.ts.
